per-channel spatial mean μ and std σ: σ keeps the fluctuation amplitude that GAP alone discards
Fig. 2. A zoomed-in view of the path-B compressor on a single redshift channel. The front face of the input cube is a real 32×32 slice (magma; top and side faces
mirrored for illustration). Dark orange cubes: 3×3×3 sampling grid of the stem. Dashed squares and rays: receptive field of one unit in each read-out stage
(RB2–RB5: 11, 17, 29 and 53 voxels; the last exceeds the box). Two stride-1 blocks keep full 32³ resolution so small-scale texture survives; each read-out stage
is summarised by per-channel mean and std, concatenated (1920-d) and mapped to t ∈ R⁴. Feature maps are illustrative; the three redshifts enter jointly as input channels.
